ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Drives rising_edge-based processes that update key_mem and xtea fields; times synchronous writes and xtea state updates.
ports.evidence: rising_edge(clk_i) in processes csr_write_access and xtea_core that assign key_mem and xtea fields

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: When '0' asynchronously clears key_mem and all xtea fields to zeros in their processes; establishes initial state.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') branches in csr_write_access and xtea_core that clear key_mem and xtea fields

ports.name: start_i
ports.functionality: When asserted with rtype_i = r3type_c, it triggers capture of rs1_i/rs2_i into xtea.opa/opb and sets xtea.done(0) to start operation.
ports.evidence: if (start_i = '1') and (rtype_i = r3type_c) then xtea.opa<=rs1_i; xtea.opb<=rs2_i; xtea.done(0)<= '1' in xtea_core

ports.name: active_i
ports.functionality: Declared but not read or used anywhere in this source.
ports.evidence: active_i appears only in the port declaration; no references in processes or concurrent assignments

ports.name: csr_we_i
ports.functionality: Gates synchronous writes into key_mem when asserted during a clock edge in csr_write_access process.
ports.evidence: if (csr_we_i = '1') then key_mem(to_integer(unsigned(csr_addr_i))) <= csr_wdata_i in csr_write_access

ports.name: csr_addr_i
ports.functionality: Selects which key_mem entry is written or read; used as array index for synchronous writes and combinational reads.
ports.evidence: key_mem(to_integer(unsigned(csr_addr_i))) used in csr_write_access and csr_rdata_o concurrent assignment

ports.name: csr_wdata_i
ports.functionality: Supplies 32-bit data that is synchronously stored into key_mem at the addressed index when csr_we_i is asserted.
ports.evidence: key_mem(...) <= csr_wdata_i inside csr_write_access on rising_edge(clk_i) when csr_we_i = '1'

ports.name: csr_rdata_o
ports.functionality: Continuously driven with the keyed key_mem entry selected by csr_addr_i; exposes stored key data to the outside.

ports.name: rtype_i
ports.functionality: Controls whether an XTEA operation is started and which result behavior is selected in result_select; enables r3-type processing.
ports.evidence: used in xtea_core condition (start_i and rtype_i = r3type_c) and in result_select if (rtype_i = r3type_c)

ports.name: funct3_i
ports.functionality: Selects arithmetic/rotation paths inside xtea_core, chooses which operand slices and key index to use, and acts as case selector in result_select.
ports.evidence: funct3_i bits used in xtea_core if/elsif to assign xtea.sum/xtea.res, in concurrent tmp_* when selectors, and as case selector in result_select

ports.name: funct7_i
ports.functionality: Declared but not read or used in this source.
ports.evidence: funct7_i appears only in port declaration; no references elsewhere

ports.name: rs1_i
ports.functionality: Provides the first operand that is captured into xtea.opa when a start is signalled for r3-type operations.
ports.evidence: xtea.opa <= rs1_i inside xtea_core when start_i and rtype_i = r3type_c

ports.name: rs2_i
ports.functionality: Provides the second operand that is captured into xtea.opb when start and rtype conditions are met.
ports.evidence: xtea.opb <= rs2_i inside xtea_core when start_i and rtype_i = r3type_c

ports.name: rs3_i
ports.functionality: Declared but not used anywhere in this source.
ports.evidence: rs3_i appears only in the port list; no other references

ports.name: result_o
ports.functionality: Combinationally driven with xtea.res for certain funct3 cases when rtype indicates r3-type; otherwise driven to zero; exported to outside.
ports.evidence: result_select assigns result_o <= xtea.res for matching funct3 cases and rtype_i = r3type_c

ports.name: valid_o
ports.functionality: Signals result validity; set from xtea.done(1) for matching cases, otherwise '0' or '1' for init case, and exported to outside.
ports.evidence: result_select assigns valid_o <= xtea.done(1) for matching funct3 cases; other branches assign explicit '0' or '1'

signals.name: key_mem
signals.functionality: Holds four 32-bit keys written synchronously from csr_wdata_i at csr_addr_i when csr_we_i is asserted; reset clears all entries; read combinationally by csr_rdata_o and tmp_z.
signals.evidence: key_mem <= (others => (others => '0')) on reset and key_mem(...) <= csr_wdata_i in csr_write_access; referenced by csr_rdata_o and tmp_z

signals.name: xtea
signals.functionality: Aggregates fields done, opa, opb, sum and res which are reset and updated synchronously in xtea_core; models XTEA internal state across cycles.
signals.evidence: signal xtea declared as record and fields assigned in xtea_core process on reset and rising_edge(clk_i)

signals.name: xtea.done
signals.functionality: LSB is set when a start occurs; MSB follows previous LSB each clock; used as valid indicator for results (valid_o).
signals.evidence: xtea.done initialized on reset; xtea.done(0)<= '0'; xtea.done(1)<= xtea.done(0); xtea.done(0)<= '1' on start in xtea_core; used in result_select

signals.name: xtea.opa
signals.functionality: Captures rs1_i when start for r3-type operations and holds operand A for use in tmp signals and xtea.sum assignment paths.
signals.evidence: xtea.opa <= rs1_i on start in xtea_core; tmp_a/tmp_b/tmp_x/tmp_y use xtea.opa in concurrent assignments; xtea.sum <= xtea.opa in one branch

signals.name: xtea.opb
signals.functionality: Captures rs2_i when start for r3-type operations and supplies operand B to tmp signals and computations.
signals.evidence: xtea.opb <= rs2_i on start in xtea_core; tmp_a/tmp_b/tmp_x/tmp_y reference xtea.opb

signals.name: xtea.sum
signals.functionality: Updated under control of funct3_i either from opa or incremented/decremented by delta; its low bits index key_mem and it participates in tmp_r arithmetic.
signals.evidence: xtea.sum set from xtea.opa or updated with +/ - xtea_delta_c in xtea_core; xtea.sum slices index key_mem in tmp_z and used in tmp_r

signals.name: xtea.res
signals.functionality: Captures the computed tmp_b +/- tmp_r value when xtea.done(0) is set and provides the result for output selection.
signals.evidence: xtea.res <= tmp_b +/- tmp_r inside xtea_core; result_select assigns result_o <= xtea.res for matching cases

signals.name: tmp_a
signals.functionality: Combinationally chooses between xtea.opb and xtea.opa depending on funct3_i(0) to serve as an operand for further computations.
signals.evidence: tmp_a <= xtea.opb when (funct3_i(0) = '0') else xtea.opa concurrent assignment

signals.name: tmp_b
signals.functionality: Combinationally selects xtea.opa or xtea.opb based on funct3_i(0) to be used in result computation.
signals.evidence: tmp_b <= xtea.opa when (funct3_i(0) = '0') else xtea.opb concurrent assignment

signals.name: tmp_x
signals.functionality: Builds a 32-bit value by concatenating xtea.opb or xtea.opa lower 28 bits with four zeros, selection governed by funct3_i(0).
signals.evidence: tmp_x <= xtea.opb(27 downto 0) & "0000" when (funct3_i(0) = '0') else xtea.opa(27 downto 0) & "0000"

signals.name: tmp_y
signals.functionality: Constructs a 32-bit value by prefixing five zeros to xtea.opb or xtea.opa upper bits (31 downto 5), chosen by funct3_i(0).
signals.evidence: tmp_y <= "00000" & xtea.opb(31 downto 5) when (funct3_i(0) = '0') else "00000" & xtea.opa(31 downto 5)

signals.name: tmp_z
signals.functionality: Reads one key_mem entry indexed by low bits of xtea.sum (different bit ranges depending on funct3_i(0)); supplies the key word to tmp_r computation.
signals.evidence: tmp_z <= key_mem(to_integer(unsigned(xtea.sum(1 downto 0)))) when (funct3_i(0) = '0') else key_mem(to_integer(unsigned(xtea.sum(12 downto 11))))

signals.name: tmp_r
signals.functionality: Computes XOR/add expressions from tmp_x,tmp_y,tmp_a and xtea.sum,tmp_z to produce an intermediate used in the final xtea.res computation.
signals.evidence: tmp_r <= std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(tmp_x xor tmp_y) + unsigned(tmp_a)) xor std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(xtea.sum) + unsigned(tmp_z))
